title: The uniquely cohomology-normalized good-truncation isomorphism
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] with a derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], with independent category, morphism and localization universes. Let $K\in D(\mathcal C)$ and suppose $H^r(K)=0$ for every integer $r\ne0$. Write $S_0:\mathcal C\to D(\mathcal C)$ for the degree-zero single functor and $s:H^0S_0\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal C}$ for the canonical single-cohomology comparison. Define the good-truncation normalization $\epsilon_K:K\xrightarrow{\sim}S_0H^0(K)$ to be the unique isomorphism of [lem-amb-derived-degree-zero-normalization] with $s_{H^0(K)}\circ H^0(\epsilon_K)=\mathrm{id}_{H^0(K)}$. Thus its data is the unique cohomology-normalized isomorphism, including in the zero abelian category.
